subject.title: Amazon Fantasy Companion: architecture, program plan, milestones

granting_owner_decisions_note: DEC-AFC-APPROVAL-001 is the identity reserved for the owner's integrated approval of this exact Phase 1 package; it does not exist until the owner records it. Opening the spec-track plan directory and running the Phase 1 spec-track planning-role sessions (Requirements Engineer, Systems Modeler; ST-1..ST-3) that write only inside docs/plans/*-amazon-fantasy-companion-phase-2/ (directory glob kept as an identifier); running the local packaged-default Requirements System host for them (cross-repo rule 14)
actions: commit with the agent author identity
merge pull requests by rebase or merge commit after one Reviewer review, at most one repair round and a green gate
fast-forward the Alphazedehq main checkout between dispatches (alphazedehq-main-checkout lease)
file issues through the issue-label policy tool in this repository
run scan-software-supply-chain and install scanned tools (uv, Graphviz) on the development host
close tracked issues after their fix merges and acceptance passes
